title: Navra, founded by SoFi and Figure co-founder Mike Cagney to make on-chain lending and securities markets more accessible, raised a $19M Series A led by Ribbit (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Navra, founded by SoFi and Figure co-founder Mike Cagney to make on-chain lending and securities markets more accessible, raised a $19M Series A led by Ribbit — Navra, the newest startup from SoFi and Figure co-founder Mike Cagney, has raised $19 million in Series A financing …
